coach.consent_sends: To answer, the coach is shown a short summary of your numbers:
coach.consent_item_numbers: Your wallet balance, income and spending by category for the last 30 days, budgets, health score and forecast.
coach.consent_item_goals: The names and progress of your savings goals.
coach.consent_item_never: It never sees your phone number, your name, who you paid, or your list of transactions.
coach.consent_how: Answers come from an AI model (OpenAI). The app calculates every number; the coach only explains them. It gives educational guidance only: no investment, loan or insurance advice. You can delete the conversation at any time.
coach.info_label: About the coach and your privacy

coach.voice_privacy_in: Speaking: your browser's speech service turns your voice into text, and may send it to its maker. If that is not available, your recording goes to OpenAI, with your permission.
coach.voice_privacy_out: Listening: answers are read aloud with a voice on your device. If it has none for the language, the answer text goes to OpenAI, with your permission.

forecast.title: Cashflow forecast
forecast.card_ok: Your balance looks safe for the next 30 days.
forecast.card_negative: Balance may go below zero around {{day}} (down to {{amount}}).
forecast.card_insufficient: Not enough history for a forecast yet. It needs about 4 weeks and 20 payments; keep adding yours.
forecast.insufficient: There is not enough transaction history yet to forecast honestly. Add or load a few weeks of transactions and check back.
forecast.no_data: Add some transactions first. We need them to build a forecast.
forecast.status_ok: Good news: your balance is expected to stay above your safety buffer ({{buffer}}) for the next 30 days.
forecast.status_low: Heads up: your balance may fall to {{amount}} on {{day}}, below your safety buffer of {{buffer}}. It first dips below the buffer on {{first}}.
forecast.status_negative: Warning: your balance may go below zero, down to {{amount}} on {{day}}. It first dips below your safety buffer of {{buffer}} on {{first}}.
forecast.low_confidence: There is not much history or no regular payments found yet, so treat this forecast as a rough guide.
forecast.chart_hint: Based on your regular income and payments plus your usual daily spending.
forecast.method_model: This forecast uses a model learned from your own spending habits (your weekly pattern and recent trend). The shaded area is where your balance is likely to stay. The low-balance warning is calculated more cautiously than the line, so it can appear even when the line stays above the buffer.
forecast.expect_hint: About {{income}} coming in and {{bills}} going out in regular payments over the next 30 days.
forecast.estimated_note: ~ means the amount varies, so we plan with a cautious estimate (lower for income, higher for payments).
forecast.backtest: Tested on your own recent history, this forecast was {{pct}}% closer to what really happened than a simple repeat-last-month guess (average error {{mae}} against {{naive}}).
forecast.how: A forecast is an estimate, not a promise. It is calculated by code from your own numbers and is for learning, not financial advice.

readiness.disclaimer: This is not a credit decision, is not shared with any lender, and does not affect your upay account.

readiness.detail_savings: You set money aside in {{active}} of the last {{observed}} months.
readiness.need_income: Not enough history yet, so this counts as a neutral 50. We need at least two full calendar months.
readiness.need_bills: No regular bill found yet, so this counts as a neutral 50. We need a bill paid at least three times.
readiness.need_months: Not enough months yet, so this counts as a neutral 50. We need at least two months of history.
readiness.need_budgets: No budgets set yet, so this counts as a neutral 50.
readiness.punctuality_proxy: Measured against the date we expect each bill from your own pattern, because upay does not give us real due dates. A close estimate, not a real due-date check.
readiness.how: The score blends four parts: income consistency (30%), bill punctuality (30%), savings consistency (25%) and budget adherence (15%). It is calculated by code from your own numbers. It is for learning only: it is not a credit decision, it is not shared with any lender, and it does not affect your upay account.

explain.title: Why this decision
explain.how: Explanations come from fixed rules, simple statistics on your own payments and a small pattern model that recognises shop names. None of it is written by a chat AI.
explain.cat_user_rule: You told us {{merchant}} belongs in {{category}}, so every payment there goes to {{category}}.
explain.cat_income_direction: Money you receive is always counted as income.
explain.cat_channel: Filed under {{category}} because {{channel}} always go there.
explain.cat_keyword: Filed under {{category}} because “{{keyword}}” appears in the merchant name or note.
explain.cat_channel_default: No keyword matched, so {{channel}} are filed under {{category}}.
explain.cat_ai: No rule matched this payment, so the AI suggested {{category}}. If it is wrong, change it below and the app will remember.
explain.cat_unmatched: No rule matched and the AI was not sure, so this is filed under {{category}} for you to check. Change it below and the app will remember.
explain.cat_model: No keyword matched, but a small pattern model recognised parts of the name (“{{factors}}”) and filed this under {{category}}. If it is wrong, change it below and the app will remember.
explain.cat_model_plain: No keyword matched, but a small pattern model recognised the kind of name and filed this under {{category}}. If it is wrong, change it below and the app will remember.
explain.cat_keyword_doubt: Filed under {{category}} because “{{keyword}}” appears in the name, but a pattern model thinks it looks more like {{suggested}}, so it is queued for you to check. Change it below if needed.
explain.cat_rule: An automatic rule filed this under {{category}}.
explain.anomaly_merchant: You paid {{amount}}. Your {{observations}} earlier payments to {{merchant}} are typically about {{typical}}, and this is far above that (score {{z}}; we flag anything above 3.5).
explain.anomaly_weekday: You paid {{amount}}. Your {{observations}} earlier {{category}} payments on this day of the week are typically about {{typical}}, and this is far above that (score {{z}}; we flag anything above 3.5).
explain.anomaly_new: This is your first payment to {{merchant}}, and {{amount}} is more than twice a typical {{category}} payment of about {{typical}}.

voice.consent_body: To understand speech in any browser, your recording is sent to OpenAI to be turned into text. The words of a spoken command, and the names of shops you often pay (to help spell them), are also sent to OpenAI. They may name a shop or a person. Recordings are not stored. You can keep typing instead.

voice.hint: Try “Add 500 taka for tea”, “Set a food budget of 4,000”, “Save 30,000 for a laptop”, “Add 500 to my laptop goal” or “Remove my last payment”.

voice.delete_none: No payment matches. Say the amount, the shop or the day, or say “my last payment”.
voice.error_rate_limited: You have used voice a lot in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
voice.error_unavailable: Voice commands are not available right now. You can still add things by hand.
voice.error_failed: I could not understand that right now. Try again or type it.
voice.refused_unclear: I did not catch something I can do. Try “Add 500 taka for tea” or “Set a food budget of 4,000”.
voice.refused_invalid_output: I could not make sense of that. Try again.

tips.title: Tip of the day
tips.coach_question: Explain this tip with my own numbers: {{tip}}
tips.forecast_dip: Your balance may dip to {{amount}} around {{day}}. Moving a bill or setting money aside now can avoid it.
tips.health_save_more: Set aside a small amount today, even Rs 50. Saving on purpose is the biggest part of your score.
tips.health_set_budgets: Pick the category you spend most on and give it a budget. It takes a minute.
tips.health_fix_budget: A budget is over its limit. Check it today and slow down in that category.
tips.health_build_buffer: Build your emergency buffer. Money for a few months of essentials keeps one bad month from hurting.
tips.health_smooth_income: Your income swings between months. Put part of the good weeks aside to cover the lean ones.
tips.generic_0: Pay yourself first: move money to savings the day income arrives, not what is left at month end.
tips.generic_1: Before a non-essential purchase, wait 24 hours. Many wants fade by tomorrow.
tips.generic_2: Pay bills a day or two early so a late fee never surprises you.
tips.generic_3: Review last week's spending once. Noticing is half of changing.
tips.generic_4: Aim for one month of essential spending in savings first, then build toward three.
tips.generic_5: Round-ups add up. Small amounts saved every day beat large amounts saved rarely.
tips.generic_6: Never share your PIN or OTP with anyone, even someone who says they are from support.
tips.generic_7: Cash out only what you need. Paying digitally keeps a record you can learn from.

import.title: Import transactions
import.subtitle: Bring in your real upay history
import.csv_hint: Export your upay statement as a CSV file and upload it. Payments already imported are skipped, so uploading the same file twice is safe.
import.opening_hint: Only needed if the file has no balance column. It sets your starting wallet balance.
import.r_rejected_one: {{count}} row could not be read and was skipped.
import.r_rejected_other: {{count}} rows could not be read and were skipped.
import.format_title: What should the file look like?
import.format_body: One row per payment, with a header row. Needed columns: date, amount and a name or description. If amounts are not negative for money out, add a Type column (Credit/Debit) or separate Credit and Debit columns. Optional: note, channel, balance. Dates without a time zone are read as Bangladesh time, day first (30/09/2026).
import.live_hint: Fetch your latest transactions straight from upay using your verified phone number.
import.err_file_too_large: That file is too large. The limit is 1 MB.
import.err_no_rows: The file has no payments in it.
import.err_too_many_rows: The file has too many rows (the limit is 5,000). Split it into smaller files.
import.err_missing_columns: The file needs a header row with date, amount and name (or description) columns.
import.err_direction_unknown: We cannot tell money in from money out. Add a Type column (Credit/Debit), separate Credit and Debit columns, or show money out as negative.
import.err_not_configured: The upay connection is not set up yet.
import.err_unauthorized: upay did not accept the connection. Please try again later.
import.err_not_found: upay has no account for your phone number.
import.err_unavailable: upay is not responding right now. Please try again later.
